labs.econ.quantilereg.presets.homo.name: Homoscedasticity
labs.econ.quantilereg.presets.skew.name: Right Skewed Distribution
labs.econ.quantilereg.notes.qrBody: min Σ ρ<sub>τ</sub>(y − Xβ), where ρ<sub>τ</sub>(u) = u·(τ − 1{u<0}).
labs.econ.quantilereg.notes.olsVsQr: OLS fits E[Y|X], QR fits Q<sub>τ</sub>(Y|X). Under <u>heteroscedasticity</u>, β<sub>τ</sub> changes with τ — information invisible to OLS.
labs.econ.quantilereg.notes.irls: This tool uses Schlossmacher (1973) IRLS (Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares) for solving (for teaching purposes, equivalent to simplex).
labs.econ.quantilereg.slopeChartNote: If the β₁(τ) curve varies with τ ⇒ presence of <u>heteroscedasticity</u> or location-scale dependence; if it aligns with the OLS horizontal line ⇒ homoscedasticity, OLS and QR are equivalent.
